description: Update a line-item product attached to a deal. All body fields optional.

billing_start_date.description: Billing start date (YYYY-MM-DD, null to clear)

comments.description: Free-text comments for this line item

discount.description: Discount applied to the line item

discount_type.description: Whether discount is a percentage or fixed amount

is_enabled.description: Whether the product is enabled on the deal

product_attachment_id.description: The product-attachment ID (the line item's own ID on the deal)

name: pipedrive_update_deal_product
